findings.F1: In a choppy market (60-day return between -10 % and +10 %), the deepest third of up days below the 20-day high, in 20-day swings, is followed by a 5-day unusual move of -7.69 % (t -3.15; 32 cases on 21 days). The middle third is followed by +1.44 % (t 0.90) and the shallowest third by +16.3 % (t 1.27). The slope of the 5-day unusual move on depth among choppy up days is 0.051 (t 2.14; 100 cases, 54 days), against 0.0048 (t 0.91) in falling markets and 0.020 (t 2.18) in rising markets.
findings.F2: The choppy fade points the same way in all four years of folds B and C. The deepest-third choppy up days' 5-day unusual move is -13.4 % in 2018, -2.0 % in 2019, -6.3 % in 2020 and -11.2 % in 2021. Over 1 day the same cases fall in every year (-2.7 %, -0.9 %, -1.1 %, -0.9 %), with the pooled deepest third at -1.16 % (t -2.12, 170 cases, 98 days).
findings.F3: In choppy markets the total 5-day move after the deepest-third up days is -6.17 %, about 28 times the 0.22 % cost of a trade. Over all markets the tested book's total move is -0.11 % per case, because the coins' normal drift of -0.82 % in the short direction offsets the +0.71 % unusual move.
findings.F4: The fade belongs to up days and grows with depth. Over 5 days, the slope of the unusual move on depth is 0.0133 for up days (t 2.72; 896 cases, 182 days) and 0.0010 for down days (t 0.24; 1120 cases, 205 days). Over 1 day the slopes are 0.0021 (t 2.28) for up days and -0.00006 (t -0.06) for down days.
findings.F5: The book loses where the coins rise and gains where they fall. In the windows where the coins' mean daily return was highest it lost: w11 -0.32 % a day while the coins made +1.93 %, w10 -0.36 % against +0.55 %. In falling windows it gained: w14 +0.28 % against -0.43 %, w7 +0.25 % against -0.47 %. Its 1112 trades of at most 5 days averaged -7.10 % net.
findings.F6: Where the close sits in the day's range adds nothing to the depth. The slope of the unusual move on close position among deep up days is -0.0077 over 1 day (t -0.85) and -0.027 over 5 days (t -0.74). Volume relative to its 20-day mean changes little: the 1-day unusual move of deep up days is -0.73 % to -0.84 % across its quartiles.

ideas.idea: In a choppy market, a day that closes up while sitting deeper below the coin's 20-day high, measured in the coin's own usual daily swing over the last 20 days, is followed by a larger fall over the next five days.
ideas.consequence: A trader can short deep up days where the coin has gone nowhere over two months: there the fall is many times the cost of a trade and the coin's drift does not work against the short.
ideas.name: choppy deep up day fade
